entities.title: Export the Linux build
entities.summary: Build the release library and export the game for Linux.
entities.when: To make a runnable build for testing; builds are not distributed until release.
entities.verify: build/linux/lodestar.x86_64 starts and shows the title, with the game pack and the library beside it.

entities.title: Godot reports an unknown SimHost
entities.summary: The scene fails to load because the library has not been built.
entities.when: Godot shows an empty window and reports a missing class or method.
steps: cargo build (or cargo build --release for an export) in games/lodestar
Reopen the project or run it again
